notes.title: Demon of the Dark - Paid to FREE
notes.content:
[h1]Why?[/h1]
Taking account of feedback, I have decided to make Demon of the Dark [b]free[/b], as many people had [u]complaints[/u] regarding it's [b]short runtime[/b]. I have also made this change because I want a [b]wider fanbase[/b] to try this game out and give the [u]best feedback possible.[/u]


[h1]When?[/h1]
This price change is expected to take place [u]as soon as Valve approves it.[/u]


[h1]What about people who bought it earlier?[/h1]
For the people who have bought it earlier, they can contact the developer showing [u]proof[/u] that they bought the game, and a steam key would be given to them to get the developer's [b]next project for free.[/b]


[h1]Further Queries[/h1]
In case of [b]further queries[/b], you can ask the developer by [u]joining the Discord[/u] Server. 


I hope this will eliminate some of the complaints. The rest will be dealt with updates that will come soon.
